title: ASML Holding N.V. Q2 2026 Form 6-K
excerpt: ASML reported Q2 2026 total net sales of EUR 9.3 billion and net income of EUR 2.9 billion, and raised its 2026 outlook to EUR 43-45 billion of sales with 54%-56% gross margin.
summary: The current SEC-hosted filing remains available and confirms the Nasdaq-listed issuer identity, strong Q2 operating result and raised full-year outlook; it does not disclose a later operating impairment or Terafab-specific order.
